title: Distinguishable Ores
description: A simple resource pack to make ores stand out among other blocks in caves.
body:
This is a simple resource pack that makes ores easier to identify in caves, due to the design and usage of OptiFine's glowing textures. As with the Totem of Undying, not much can be said about this. This resource pack is now available for 1.20.1 and 1.19.2 after a fairly long amount of time without the port being made, oops!

OptiFine is required.
